Name: Suan Kiba
Information:
**Suan Kiba**

**Title** The Coiling Mirror
**Gemstone** Red Opal
**Type** Seraphael
**Originator** Luxus

Suān Kiba is the advisor, speaker for, and guardian of Suzaku no Sorani, serving as its point of communication between outsiders and the guardian of its material Divine Realm. Suān Kiba performs whatever is asked of it by Suzaku no Sorani, and in Southern Cu Chullis it is recognized as the representative of a deity. In meetings of the Court of Divine Beasts, they authoritatively represent Suzaku no Sorani.

Stat Blocks.title: Suan Kiba
Stat Blocks.ability_note:
*the checks, saves, and skills listed includes their +2 Cosmogony Bonus

Cosmogony Bonus: +3

traits.name: Seraphic Authority: Red Mirror
traits.description: As long as it wishes them to, Suān Kiba’s scales give off a supernaturally bright red light, which punishes those who attempt to strike it from afar. Each time a creature targets them with an attack or effect from further than 30 feet away, they are treated as though blinded, as their vision of Suān Kiba perceives them as a burning red source of blinding light.

traits.name: Voice of Familiarity
traits.description: When Suān Kiba speaks, its voice is heard as one that is innately trusted by any listening to it, often speaking as a loved one, friend, or figure of authority. It has advantage on Charisma-based checks made against others.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Suān Kiba makes two Opal Bite attacks. If it hits a target with the first, it can replace the second with its Shining Constriction against the same target.

actions.name: Opal Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Shining Constriction
actions.description:
A target within 10 feet is bound by Suān Kiba, and must make a DC 20 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the target is grappled (escape DC 22). Until the grapple ends the target is restrained. At the start of each of Suān Kiba’s turns, its grappled target(s) takes 22 (4d10) radiant damage as Suān Kiba’s body burns it with radiant red light.

Suān Kiba can constrict up to four Medium-size targets (a Large creature counts as two, a Huge creature counts as three, and so on) at a time, and can drag them with it as it moves, which it can do uninhibited by them.

bonus_actions.name: Cosmic Shard: Cycle of Restoration (Recharge 5-6)
bonus_actions.description: Suān Kiba’s body dries, cracks, and breaks apart as it sheds its skin. It regains 100 hit points, its size increases by one category, its reach extends by 5 feet, its Damage Threshold increases by 5, it ends any effects causing unwanted conditions on it, its Shining Constriction can constrict an additional two Medium-sized creatures, and for 10 minutes its attacks deal an additional d8 of radiant damage. After 10 minutes, its body curls into a ball, solidifies, and it returns to its original size and form.

bonus_actions.name: Form of Familiarity
bonus_actions.description: Suān Kiba can transform into a Medium or Large humanoid form, which can have whatever characteristics it wishes. While its statistics remain the same (excluding its size), its reach becomes 5 feet, and its Shining Constriction can only target one creature of its size or smaller. Its humanoid form can assume one familiar to another creature Suān Kiba is conversing with, but appears as a bleached, albino version of that creature. It can use this action again to resume its true form.

options.name: Attack
options.description: Suān Kiba makes an Opal Bite attack against a creature within reach.

options.name: Detection
options.description: Suān Kiba makes a Perception check.

options.name: Restoring Light (Costs 2 Actions)
options.description: Suān Kiba blesses itself and up to four other creatures within 60 feet of it with divine protection, causing each target to gain 22 (4d10) temporary hit points.

options.name: Self-Protection (Costs 3 Actions)
options.description: Suān Kiba wraps its head and vital spots with the coils of its body, granting it resistance to all damage it takes until the start of its next turn. However, it becomes blinded during that time as well (regardless of its blindsight).
